name: Nepali Bhanchha
summary: Dal-bhat-tarkari twice a day, fermented gundruk and millet dhido from Himalayan homes.

foods.name: Dal Bhat Tarkari
foods.blurb: Lentil soup, rice and a vegetable curry. 'Dal bhat power, 24 hour!'

foods.name: Gundruk Soup
foods.blurb: Fermented, sun-dried mustard greens made into a tangy soup.

foods.name: Dhido
foods.blurb: Thick millet or buckwheat porridge eaten with greens and dal.

foods.name: Kwati
foods.blurb: A soup of nine kinds of sprouted beans, made for the festival of Janai Purnima.

foods.name: Rayo ko Saag
foods.blurb: Mustard greens stir-fried with garlic and chilli.

foods.name: Steamed Momo
foods.blurb: Steamed dumplings filled with vegetables or meat.

foods.name: Sel Roti
foods.blurb: Sweet, ring-shaped rice bread fried for Tihar. A sometimes treat!
